phase_name: Acceptance verification and full gate run

objectives.description: Run every orchestrate test, confirm green
Run full gate suite (run-all.sh + verify-deploy.sh lints)
Record all measurements in implementation summary

deviations.description: commands/orchestrate.md still had a pre-rewrite len(TASK_NUMBERS)==1 branch falling through to a now-deleted single-task CHECKPOINT 1/STAGE 2/CHECKPOINT 2/CHECKPOINT 3 sequence for the DEFAULT invocation shape (a bare /orchestrate N with no ORCHESTRATE_BATCH_OF_ONE env var). This was outside this task's originally-scoped Files to modify list (which named only SKILL.md, scripts, docs, tests, lints, and the registry) but is a direct, load-bearing consequence of deleting the single-task engine: without this fix, the default /orchestrate N invocation would build a delegation-context shape (task_number singular, no task_numbers array) the rewritten SKILL.md cannot consume.
deviations.reason: Fixed as part of Phase 7's acceptance verification, which is exactly what surfaced it (the plan's own Phase 7 task explicitly required confirming the single-task-number path works). Removed the dead branch, the ORCHESTRATE_BATCH_OF_ONE flag, and the entire unreachable CHECKPOINT 1-3 sequence. Bonus: commands/orchestrate.md shrank from 21,607 B to 15,812 B. Full gate run (73/73 tests, 30/30 verify-deploy checks) reconfirmed green after the fix.
deviations.annotation: See Phase 7 task-4 checklist annotation in the plan file for the full account

deviations.description: The 'live 5-task batch' and 'live AskUserQuestion round-trip' acceptance demonstrations were performed via isolated, throwaway fixture repos exercising the real scripts, rather than a genuinely live /orchestrate invocation against real tasks in this repo's own state.json.
deviations.reason: A genuinely live run would dispatch real Agent-tool calls against unrelated real tasks and mutate their real state -- a significant side-effect footprint and resource cost outside an implementation agent's own delegated scope, and a decision better made deliberately by the orchestrator/user than as a side effect of this implementation dispatch. The isolated-fixture runs exercise the identical script code paths and JSON shapes as the live path, and are corroborated by the pre-existing, much larger test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh fixture suite (which does run these scripts live, just against synthetic state).
deviations.annotation: See Phase 7 task-3/task-5 checklist annotations in the plan file
